newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MARQUET, LIBBRA ON TRIAL WITH ENGLISH CLUBS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARQUET, LIBBRA ON TRIAL WITH ENGLISH CLUBS.

text.p: Marseille defender Jean-Christophe Marquet and striker Marc Libbra are on trial with English premier league clubs Chelsea and Bolton Wanderers respectively this week, club sources said on Wednesday.
Marquet, who missed a chunk of last season through injury, is looking to link up at Chelsea with fellow Frenchmen Franck Leboeuf and Bernard Lambourde.
Libbra, like Marquet a product of the former European champions' youth scheme, is tipped to sign for coach Colin Todd's promoted Bolton. He scored nine league goals last season.
